Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nth.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 26-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professionals posts at National Test House?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Young Professionals posts at National Test House is 26th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Young Professionals posts?
faq.answer: For Sr. YP, candidates need qualifications in RPPT, Microbiology, Electrical, Civil, Management, Chemical, or Mechanical fields. For Jr. YP, qualifications in Electrical, Microbiology, RPPT, IT, or Aerospace are required. A graduate or postgraduate degree is generally expected.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Young Professionals?
faq.answer: There are a total of 36 vacancies for Young Professionals posts at the National Test House. This includes vacancies for both Senior Young Professionals (Sr. YP) and Junior Young Professionals (Jr. YP).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professionals posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for Sr. YP is Rs. 70,000/- per month, and for Jr. YP, it is Rs. 40,000/- per month. These are fixed monthly payments for the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Young Professionals recruitment at National Test House is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the official website of National Test House?
faq.answer: The official website of National Test House is www.nth.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website to download the detailed advertisement and application form.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no mention of any application fee for the Young Professionals posts in the official notification. Candidates should verify this in the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Young Professionals at National Test House are on a contract basis. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any specific age limits mentioned for the Young Professionals posts?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify the exact age limits for the Young Professionals posts. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information regarding age criteria and any applicable relaxations.

faq.answer: For Sr. YP, qualifications include RPPT, Microbiology, Electrical, Civil, Management, Chemical, and Mechanical. For Jr. YP, the required qualifications are Electrical, Microbiology, RPPT, IT, and Aerospace. A graduate or postgraduate degree is the basic educational requirement.
